Diagnostic.description: One structured finding with a stable code, the JSON Pointer of the input it concerns, a message and a repair hint.

code.description: Stable code such as `CRN-E012` or `CRN-W001`, part of the machine contract.

message.description: Human-readable detail; its wording is not part of the contract.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty string denotes the document root.

Severity.description: Whether a diagnostic blocks use of the input or result: `error` does, `warning` is advisory.

description: Result of `check`: whether a model, and optionally a run, passed parsing and validation.

diagnostics.description: Parse errors (the first per document) and every validation error and warning.

execution_available.description: Always false: a check report is not a simulation result.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact model bytes; null only when an input file could not be read.

run_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact run bytes when a run was checked.

scope.description: Always `structural_and_domain_validation`: no rate is evaluated and nothing runs.

valid.description: True when no diagnostic has severity `error`.

title: CheckReport
